headline: Türkiye and Uzbekistan Target $5 Billion in Annual Bilateral Trade
summary: Türkiye and Uzbekistan signed agreements to expand bilateral trade and investment, aiming to lift two-way trade volume to $5 billion from approximately $3.1 billion in 2025.
why: Central Asian trade corridors are expanding as regional powers seek new supply chain routes and bilateral investment partnerships across Eurasia.
